description: In front of you on a red surface is a small white block-built chair or bench structure, with a loose small cube piece nearby. The left hand stays on the main chair structure to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand picks up the small cube as a right-hand object, brings it inward, and slides it into a side slot on the chair; the right hand then lets go and pulls back while the left hand continues to hold the structure steady.
